newsitem.title: HONDURAS: North and Central America port conditions -Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: North and Central America port conditions -Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

HONDURAS, Jan 6 - Puerto Cortes - Vessels berthed, 3 discharging/loading containers, 1 discharging general. Vessels awaiting berth, 2 to discharge/load containers, 1 to discharge wheat. Vessels due, 1 to discharge fuel, 2 to discharge wheat, 5 to discharge bananas, 1 passenger vessel. Jan 7 - Two vessels berthed of which 1 discharging/loading containers, 1 cruise vessel. 2 Vessels anchored of which 1 lumber, 1 in ballast. 15 Due of which 7 to discharge/load containers, 5 to load bananas, 1 to discharge fuel oil, 1 to discharger wheat and soya, 1 to discharge wheat. No berthing delays expected.

MEXICO, Jan 7 - Tampico - Vessels in port, 1 lead concentrate, 1 aluminium, 1 general cargo, 2 iron, 1 sugar, 1 coal/coke, 1 repair, 2 cement, 1 corn, 1 gasoline and diesel, 1 anchored with beans. Working normally. Altamira - Vessels in port, 2 containers, 1 repair. Working normally. Veracruz - Vessels in port, 3 pipes, 2 general cargo, 3 grain, 2 corn, 3 sugar, 1 scrap, 1 repair. Working normally. Manzanillo - Vessels in port, 2 grain, 2 cars, 2 general cargo, 2 clinker, 1 fruit, 1 palm oil. Working normally. Coatzacoalcos - Vessels in port, 7 oil tankers, 9 chemicals. Working normally.

PANAMA, Jan 6 - Balboa - Vessels due, 1 bulker, 1 vehicle carrier. Cristobal - Vessels due, 1 general/reefer, 1 passenger vessel. Panama Canal - Transit booking system working to full capacity. 31 Vessels due, 34 in queue, 16 booked, 40 scheduled.
